question: What will be the ending value of the UST 10Y Yield for these biweekly periods of Q3 2026? (Sep 21 - Oct 2)

calls.reasoning: Spot is ~4.96 (DGS10 4.95 Sep 10, 4.96 Sep 11; 5.01 intraday Sep 14), the highest since Oct 2023. At a 13-session horizon the random walk dominates, so I center on spot. Upward: +52bp trend over the quarter, oil >$100 on US-Iran/Houthi escalation, above-target CPI, heavy issuance, a Fed about to deliver its first hike since 2023 (83-90% priced), and Barrow (Standard Bank) raising his year-end target to 5.2%. Downward: the hike is already in the price so the FOMC is a buy-the-fact risk; 5% is a documented real-money demand zone (Oct 2023 peaked at 5.02% then fell ~80bp); softer July employment/retail sales means a weak Sep payrolls print on Oct 2 could rally the market into the resolution timestamp; quarter-end index extension adds duration demand. These roughly offset, leaving a tiny upward tilt from carry/rolldown and momentum. No shutdown tail (CR signed Sep 2 funds to Dec 11). No usable market anchor: Polymarket/Manifold have nothing, Kalshi's weekly 10Y contracts exist but both fetch attempts returned HTTP 429, so I blended with nothing. Main uncertainty is dispersion, not the center: the upper bound sits only ~30bp away, which a hawkish dot plot or a further oil leg reaches, so I price 6% escape and let the interior percentiles describe the conditional distribution.
